title: Projective measurements describe every cognitive effect

statements.text: The first stage of quantum-like modeling represented questions by projective measurements, the canonical measurements of quantum physics.

standing.reason: Data on aesthetic perception in literature violate the QQ-equality, which every projective model satisfies, so those data cannot be modeled with projective measurements.

sources.quote: The first stage of the development of quantum-like modeling was characterized by employment of the projective measurements
